'''Tronus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was the apprentice of [[Darth Xarion]], and secretly a member of the obscure Sith cult known as "[[The Unmasked]]". Unbeknownst to him, Darth Xarion learned of his secret, but was unable to make any moves against him without alerting the rest of the cult that he was aware of their activities.<ref name="Unmasked" />
